title: Splunk Persistent XSS via Props Conf
author: Rod Soto
description: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 9.2.3 and 9.1.6 and Splunk Cloud Platform versions below 9.2.2403.108 and 9.1.2312.205, a low-privileged user that does not hold the “admin” or “power” Splunk roles could craft a malicious payload through entity.details in props.conf that could result in execution of unauthorized JavaScript code in the browser of a user.
